SQL
SELECT
Statement



The SQL SELECT Statement

The
SELECT
statement is used to select data from a database.

SELECT Syntax

SELECT
column1
,
column2, ...
FROM
table_name
;

Here,
column1, column2, ...
are the
column names
in the table you want to select data from.

The
table_name
represents the
name of the table
you want to select data from.
